title: The LetterPress WordPress plugin before 2.4.0 does not sanitise and escape some of its settings, which could allow…
description: The LetterPress WordPress plugin versions before 2.4.0 do not properly sanitise and escape certain settings. This vulnerability allows high privilege users, such as administrators, to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks even if the unfiltered_html capability is disabled, for example in multisite WordPress setups.
